requirements.requirement: The system must execute unit tests validating that raw measure values are correctly transformed into normalized scores based on defined formulas.
The system must execute unit tests validating that each measure’s contribution to the final score is correctly calculated using its weight and normalized score.
The system must verify through unit tests that normalization logic produces deterministic outputs for identical inputs across multiple runs.
The system must validate via unit tests that all required fields (measure_id, raw_value, normalized_score, weight, contribution_to_final_score) are present in the explainability schema.
The system must execute integration tests confirming that the evaluate_care_facade returns a complete explainability payload including all measures.
The system must validate via integration tests that the API endpoint returns the explainability payload in the expected contract format.
The system must verify through integration tests that the sum of all contribution_to_final_score values equals the final score within an acceptable tolerance.
The system must ensure unit tests fail when invalid normalization inputs (e.g., null or non-numeric raw values) are provided.
The system must ensure integration tests fail when the explainability payload is missing one or more required schema fields.
The system must validate that API responses containing explainability data return HTTP 200 status on successful requests.
The system must validate that API responses return an appropriate error status when explainability generation fails.
The system must ensure test coverage includes both single-measure and multi-measure scoring scenarios.
The system must validate that floating point precision is handled consistently in normalization and contribution calculations within defined tolerance limits.
The system must ensure integration tests validate end-to-end flow from API request through facade to explainability logic and back to response.
